svg.title: No-reference periodic canceller
svg.desc: A high-band split protects low-frequency scene content from the delayed predictor.
svg.text: A high-band split protects low-frequency scene content from the delayed predictor.
LMS feedback uses high-band error, not the complete-image residual.
L = 32; Δ = 8; α = .015; split σ = 4 px (small-demo settings)
ΔPSNR +12.73 dB • 96 × 64 synthetic pixels • independent educational implementation, not the camera benchmark
